title: The Inheritance Games
author: Jennifer Lynn Barnes
summary: A teenager who is barely scraping by learns that a billionaire she has never met has left her nearly his whole fortune. To claim it she must move into his mansion, full of puzzles, with the family he disinherited.
readIf: you want a twisty, puzzle-box young-adult mystery with banter and a bit of romance.
skipIf: you want realistic, slow-burn detection, since the plot depends on grand, improbable puzzles.

pairings.reason: Another quick young-adult mystery with secrets, suspects and a lot of teen drama.
A teenage detective story with more tangible stakes and a darker core.
An adult, much darker take on privileged young people tangled up in a death.
